483f71fbc8a98e1d.description: About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility. Position Overview The Senior Technician supports ECU Manufacturing through hands-on technical execution for software-release readiness, ECU flashing, manufacturing testing, and sustaining production. The role independently supports pre-release testing, maintains flashing tools and test-station computers, and resolves technical issues affecting engineering builds and production rollout. The position applies advanced practical knowledge of electronics, Windows-based systems, wiring diagrams, harnesses, connectors, diagnostic interfaces, and electrical troubleshooting while coordinating with manufacturing test engineers, technical program managers, software engineers, operations teams, and contract manufacturers across multiple programs. Key Responsibilities Establish, maintain, and track ECU software releases for engineering builds and production activities. Act as the primary technician supporting users and coordinating software-release activities within the flashing area. Execute the in-house ECU software-release process with Manufacturing Test, Operations, and contract manufacturers. Collaborate with technical program managers, software engineers, and test engineers to implement and maintain release tools, processes, and supporting solutions. Provide software-file locations, flashing tools, traceability information, and related technical support for engineering builds and production. Communicate activities, risks, issues, and status for assigned programs to the responsible Test Engineer. Review, track, and support sign-off of software DEVREQs and ECRs for internal and external ECUs. Coordinate multiple concurrent releases, builds, and deployments from development through production rollout. Execute and track pre-release software testing in the Manufacturing Test laboratory, contract-manufacturer locations, and internal sites. Track open software and test-station issues, perform technical troubleshooting, and drive assigned actions to resolution. Inspect, troubleshoot, repair, and verify harnesses, connectors, wiring, and pinouts used in ECU flashing and test stations. Diagnose and resolve USB, Ethernet, serial, diagnostic-interface, and flashing-tool communication issues. Maintain test-station computers through Windows troubleshooting, software setup, driver installation, network-connectivity support, and peripheral configuration. Provide practical technical guidance to other technicians and users within the assigned scope when required. Skills Advanced practical knowledge of ECU flashing, manufacturing test activities, electronics troubleshooting, and production support. Strong working knowledge of Windows operating systems, test-station computers, software installation, drivers, networks, and peripheral configuration. Ability to read wiring diagrams, connector pinouts, and technical instructions and independently troubleshoot harnesses, connectors, and electrical circuits. Ability to diagnose USB, Ethernet, serial, diagnostic-interface, and flashing-tool communication issues. Ability to manage multiple concurrent releases, builds, testing activities, and issue resolution actions. Strong technical documentation, status reporting, organization, and traceability discipline. Ability to work effectively with manufacturing, engineering, operations, suppliers, and contract manufacturers across different regions. Knowledge of UDS, CAN, and DoIP protocols at user level is preferred. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and Windows-based systems. Minimum Qualifications Technical diploma in Automotive Technology, Electronics, Mechatronics, or a related technical field. 6+ years of relevant hands-on experience in automotive diagnostics, ECU flashing, electronics troubleshooting, manufacturing testing, production support, or a closely related technical environment. Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot ECU flashing systems, test station computers, wiring, harnesses, connectors, diagnostic interfaces, and communication issues. Practical experience supporting software releases, engineering builds, manufacturing test activities, or production rollout. Automotive manufacturing or production-support experience is preferred. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations. Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website. Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. To all recruitment agencies: Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Lucid Motors. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

48efbc46854d707d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة الشريك التقني لتقنية المعلومات عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في الدلم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بناء علاقات العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإدارة عمليات البيع والتحصيل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات، وإعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء. كما يتولى مسؤولية التواصل مع العملاء لتقديم عروض البيع، إتمام الصفقات، ومتابعة تحصيل الديون، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الدورية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع توثيق بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء من خلال الزيارات أو الاتصالات لترويج المنتجات والخدمات، وتقديم عروض البيع مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المخولة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، وتوريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع البيانات وتحليلها. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، الدلم. سيعمل الموظف ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المؤسسة وتوسيع قاعدة عملائها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

480c57f4227f8ff8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ميد يان للخدمات الطبية عن فني دعم تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الفني والمساعدة للموظفين والعملاء الذين يواجهون تحديات في مجال تقنية المعلومات، وضمان استمرارية العمليات التقنية بسلاسة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة ويعتبر فرصة للمتخصصين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الفني والمساعدة للموظفين والعملاء، والرد على استفساراتهم بهدف حل المشاكل التقنية التي تواجههم. تحديد الأدوات والمستلزمات اللازمة لأعمال الدعم الفني وحل المشاكل، ورفع الاحتياجات إلى الجهات المعنية لتأمينها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. توفير المعلومات الفنية المتعلقة بأجهزة ونظم وبرامج تقنية المعلومات، والتصعيد إلى أخصائيي تقنية المعلومات عند الحاجة لمشاكل معقدة. حفظ وتصنيف البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بجميع عمليات الدعم الفني المقدمة، بالاستناد إلى الممارسات المعتمدة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال دعم تقنية المعلومات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحديد المشاكل التقنية وتقديم الحلول المناسبة. معرفة جيدة بأنظمة التشغيل، والبرامج المكتبية، ومكونات الأجهزة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم الدعم الفني بوضوح وفعالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وحل المشكلات بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية لتوثيق وحفظ المعلومات والتقارير. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة داعمة تهدف إلى تقديم أفضل الخدمات الطبية. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة ميد يان للخدمات الطبية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية.

48b9f3536326a02c.job_title: Florist Fresh Flower Arranger and Bouquet Designer

This full-time role involves providing technical and operational expertise to manage the procurement process for all projects within Kidana's Projects Departments. The specialist will ensure that goods and services are acquired efficiently, cost-effectively, and meet high quality standards and operational needs. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation of procurement strategies and plans aligned with Kidana's objectives and project requirements. Apply procurement policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards, transparency, and accountability. Monitor procurement budgets and identify any deviations to maintain spending within approved limits and ensure cost-effectiveness. Conduct evaluations of potential vendors, negotiate contracts, and manage supplier relationships to ensure timely delivery and quality standards. Support the end-to-end procurement process, from sourcing to delivery and inventory coordination, to ensure efficiency. Assist in the execution of risk mitigation measures related to procurement activities. Collaborate with other departments to ensure procurement activities support organizational goals. Maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including suppliers, customers, and regulatory agencies. Perform comparative analysis of quotations, identifying pricing, delivery terms, warranties, and unique vendor offerings. Implement and execute the Procurement Committee process. 4802638f4b5760de.description: About the Role Bechtel Corporation is seeking a BIM Lead to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for implementing BIM processes to support project delivery and manage the cross-functional collaboration environment, ensuring compliance with the Project BIM Execution Plan (BEP). Project Context Bechtel has managed the Jubail project since the mid-1970s, a significant civil engineering undertaking that continues to expand. Saudi Arabian Bechtel Company (SABCO) serves as the Management Services Contractor (MSC) for the Royal Commission (RC), overseeing engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) management. The renewed contract, extending to June 2026, focuses on developing new residential communities, iconic buildings, infrastructure, and various public facilities in Jubail and Ras Al-Khair Industrial Cities. Key Responsibilities Develop and review project BIM strategy, requirements, and BIM Execution Plans (BEPs). Ensure coordination of BIM activities, including coordinate systems, standard templates, clash management, and design review, among design subcontractors. Provide BIM production support, maintaining the Common Data Environment (CDE), model federation, interference management, quality checking, and deliverable generation. Develop, enhance, and institutionalize standardized BIM workflows for project stakeholders and subcontractors. Develop and enhance standard processes for BIM/3D model health checks against project requirements. Maintain project Exchange Information Requirements for flow-down to the supply chain. Train the project delivery team on the CDE (ProjectWise) and associated BIM workflows. Develop standard workflows for interoperability between BIM/CAD and GIS to support construction, safety, sustainability, and permitting processes. Conduct regular assessments to review BEP implementation, capture lessons learned, and identify improvement opportunities. Serve as a liaison between the Royal Commission, delivery team, and IT for BIM-related issue resolution. Perform and manage work in accordance with relevant Project Procedures and information requirements (EIR/AIR/PIR). Create standard processes for model-based design quantity take-offs and enable construction quantity reporting and forecasting. Support design and construction reviews, coordination, and manage issue/action logs. Visit job sites to facilitate BIM discussions and execution. Provide operational support to BIM coordinators, including BIM Leads at third-party engineering consultants, design firms, and subcontractors. Participate regularly with the off-project functional BIM team for training, development, knowledge sharing, and lessons learned. Develop processes to integrate BIM/3D models with schedules for 4D construction sequence simulation. Develop processes to integrate BIM/3D models and Quantity Take-off Templates for construction progress tracking and reporting. Ensure the project meets information requirements and industry standards (*, ISO19650). Capture lessons learned and manage the implementation of improved workflows. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience. Required Skills Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to explain new work processes and technologies across all organizational levels. Self-motivated with good interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively within a multi-cultural, integrated RC/Bechtel team environment. Capable of managing priorities and adapting to evolving responsibilities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia, working within an integrated team environment focused on large-scale civil engineering and construction projects.

485133f5d1659637.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فاينكيور كولكشن سوليشنز عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ويضمن تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه عمليات تقدير الموازنات المالية، وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، وضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وبتكلفة تقديرية. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع المشاريع والبرامج الأخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقاً للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وعملية إغلاقه، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها للأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في إدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لعمليات تطوير خطط تنفيذ المشاريع والبرامج. القدرة على مراقبة سير العمل وتتبع الموازنات والإجراءات التعاقدية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. القدرة على تحديد المخاطر ووضع حلول فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التنسيق والتواصل مع فرق العمل والأطراف المعنية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الدورية ورفعها للإدارة العليا. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتطلب العمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المشاريع بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

48b441332a9a9fed.description: About the Role WSP is seeking a Senior Testing, Commissioning & Completion Manager to lead and manage all testing, commissioning, system completion, integration, operational readiness, and handover activities for a major infrastructure project in Riyadh. The company is committed to innovation, empowerment, and sustainability, focusing on the growth of its employees and the communities it serves. The Role of Systems Integration Engineer Tamer Healthcare is seeking a Systems Integration Engineer to join its team. This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves managing work orders, addressing customer complaints, and ensuring high customer satisfaction through technical support and understanding client needs. Key Responsibilities Manage the timely completion of work orders and resolution of customer complaints. Engage with customers to understand, anticipate, and meet their requirements, aiming for high satisfaction ratings. Provide technical advice and support to customers. Forecast territory sales and plan daily activities based on customer potential within the assigned territory. Conduct field visits, calls, and presentation sessions for healthcare professionals using approved product materials to ensure consistent prescription. Establish and maintain strong relationships with all customers. Report territory forecasting against annual targets to ensure achievement. Document daily activities using the company's reporting system. Report market feedback and competitor activities to the direct manager for necessary actions. Undertake additional duties or assignments as required by management. Candidate Profile Tamer Healthcare values individuals who bring passion to their work, think innovatively, and are proactive in sharing ideas. Candidates should be committed to working with integrity and respecting diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Work Environment and Culture As a member of Tamer Healthcare, you will be part of an organization that prides itself on its industry leadership and commitment to its people. The company fosters an environment of mutual respect and shared pride in its work and industry. Application Process Join Tamer Healthcare and contribute to an organization with a century of expertise dedicated to creating a healthier future.

48c0525735a7098a.description: About the Role eXtra is seeking an Electronics Service Technician to join their team in Riyadh. This is a full-time position focused on providing essential service and support for electronic products. This role is critical in ensuring customer satisfaction through effective and timely technical service. Conduct routine maintenance and calibration of electronic products. Ensure all service activities comply with established quality standards and procedures. Document all service and repair actions accurately. Qualifications and Requirements Proven experience as an Electronics Service Technician or in a similar role. The role requires hands-on technical work in a dynamic retail and service environment. Application Process Candidates interested in this Electronics Service Technician role are encouraged to apply.

48e767d8fa10eed8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الانشاء المتقدم للمقاولات عن مهندس إنشائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وتصميم ومراجعة الخطط الإنشائية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية حساب حجم وشكل ومقاومة ونوع العناصر الإنشائية، أو إجراء تحليل إنشائي للعناصر مسبقة التصميم. تصميم العناصر الإنشائية بناءً على الأحمال المقدرة. تفقد الإنشاءات القائمة والتوصية بإصلاح أو استبدال العناصر الإنشائية المعيبة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها. عرض وتوضيح وحفظ التقارير والوثائق في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الإنشائية. القدرة على تخطيط وتصميم ومراجعة خطط تركيب العناصر الإنشائية. فهم عميق لتحليل الإجهادات الهيكلية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في التحليل والتصميم الإنشائي. القدرة على إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الفنية بدقة. مهارات التواصل الفعال والعمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بتطوير الأساليب والإجراءات ومواكبة التطورات التقنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة الانشاء المتقدم للمقاولات، حيث تتاح الفرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع إنشائية متنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

489cc8105bc60d3f.description: We are looking for an experienced Investment Manager to join a leading organization in Riyadh and play a key role in identifying, evaluating, executing, and managing strategic investment opportunities. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in investment analysis, financial modeling, M&A, due diligence, portfolio management, and investment risk assessment , with a demonstrated track record of participating in successful investment transactions. Identify and assess attractive investment opportunities across local and regional markets. Conduct comprehensive financial and investment analysis to support investment decisions. Build and review financial models, including NPV, IRR, ROI, payback period, sensitivity analysis, and scenario analysis . Evaluate potential acquisitions, strategic partnerships, joint ventures, and other investment opportunities. Lead and coordinate financial, legal, commercial, operational, and technical due diligence processes. Participate in investment transactions from initial evaluation and structuring through negotiation and closing. Monitor the performance of existing investments and portfolios and recommend corrective actions where required. Identify investment risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies, risk limits, early-warning indicators, and exit plans. Support the development and implementation of investment policies, governance frameworks, and approval processes. Prepare professional investment proposals and presentations for senior management and the Board, covering opportunities, alternatives, risks, returns, scenarios, and recommendations. Support financing strategies and evaluate optimal capital structures for investment opportunities. Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, funds, banks, developers, advisors, and relevant stakeholders. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Investment, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA, Master’s in Finance/Investment, or a related postgraduate qualification is preferred. 12+ years of relevant experience in investment, portfolio management, corporate finance, private equity, real estate investment, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in an Investment Manager or comparable managerial role . Demonstrated experience in investment transactions, M&A, strategic partnerships, financing, and/or real estate development. Strong financial modeling, valuation, feasibility study, and investment analysis capabilities. Strong understanding of investment risk management and portfolio performance. Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills. CFA and/or CAIA certification is highly preferred.

48cc1c72187ed855.description: Alomar Holding Company, a leading Saudi Arabian investment group specializing in real estate development and construction, is seeking a Procurement Manager to drive procurement excellence across its diverse business units. As part of a dynamic organization committed to quality, governance, and sustainable growth, you will play a pivotal role in shaping procurement strategies that support long-term value creation and align with the Kingdom’s economic vision. Key responsibilities include: Develop and implement comprehensive procurement strategies to support company goals. Lead and manage the procurement team across various business units, providing guidance and mentorship. Negotiate contracts and agreements with suppliers to secure favorable terms and cost savings. Monitor market trends and supplier performance to identify risks and opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to forecast procurement needs and ensure timely delivery of goods and services. Ensure compliance with company policies, legal regulations, and ethical standards in all procurement activities. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance procurement processes, efficiency, and value creation. Manage supplier relationships to build strong partnerships and ensure quality and reliability of supply. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field 7+ years of procurement experience, including at least 3 years in a managerial role leading teams Procurement experience within construction or real estate development, including sourcing construction materials and subcontractor services Hands-on experience with strategic sourcing, negotiation, contract management, and procurement process improvement Experience using Odoo ERP or similar procurement systems Knowledge of relevant legal and regulatory procurement frameworks Business fluent in Arabic and English Proven ability to partner with internal stakeholders across finance, legal, operations, and project/construction teams, and to present procurement strategies to senior leadership Preferred Qualifications: MBA or equivalent advanced degree Experience managing logistics contracts within procurement Experience monitoring supplier performance and driving supplier relationship management initiatives Experience managing external stakeholder relationships with suppliers, subcontractors, and logistics/service providers Experience presenting procurement savings and risk updates to board-level stakeholders Comprehensive medical insurance coverage Pension scheme in accordance with Saudi labor regulations Paid annual leave and public holidays Professional development and training opportunities

48414cce39945403.description: About the Role Alfanar Projects is seeking a Senior Cost Control Engineer to manage and forecast costs for construction projects. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves establishing project budgets, tracking actual costs and commitments, identifying potential overruns, and providing reliable forecasts to project teams for early intervention. Key Responsibilities Set up project cost breakdown structures and budgets using SAP or similar project cost systems. Review project scope and requirements to prepare detailed estimates to complete. Track actual costs, commitments, and budget changes throughout the project lifecycle. Compare budgeted costs with actual and forecast costs, identify overruns, and provide explanations. Prepare and regularly update cost forecasts, project cash flows, and cost reports. Analyze percentage of completion, project progress, and financial performance in collaboration with project and finance teams. Review proposed budget revisions and reconcile cost figures with the Finance department. Collaborate with project execution, planning, resources, and supply chain teams to obtain accurate cost and progress information. Highlight cost risks early and recommend practical actions to protect project profitability. Support cost-saving initiatives without compromising project requirements or delivery schedules. Prepare clear reports and dashboards for project teams and management. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering. 5-10 years of hands-on cost control experience in a large construction or EPC company. Demonstrated experience in setting up project budgets, tracking costs, and preparing forecasts and financial reports. Good understanding of estimates to complete, cash flow forecasting, percentage of completion (POC), and project cost performance. Working experience with SAP PS/CO or a similar project cost management system. Strong Excel skills. Ability to clearly explain cost variances and work closely with both project teams and Finance. Preferred Qualifications CCP or PMP certification. Experience using Earned Value Management (EVM). Experience with Primavera and Power BI. Work Environment This role operates within a dynamic project environment, requiring close collaboration with various teams including project execution, planning, resources, and supply chain. The position is full-time, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

48bae486b62a66eb.description: About Medtronic Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology, dedicated to alleviating pain, restoring health, and extending life. With 95,000 employees across more than 150 countries, the company focuses on developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of over 72 million patients annually. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to the future of healthcare within a purpose-driven environment. The Role: Sales Representative – Spine Medtronic is seeking a full-time, customer-oriented Sales Representative – Spine to support its Surgical Innovations Business in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This position is suitable for a professional with 2-5 years of experience in the medical device industry, possessing strong relationship management skills and a natural ability to identify business opportunities. The primary purpose of this role is to sell and support a range of Medtronic Spinal and Biologics products, drive clinical adoption, and ensure optimal product usage in hospitals and surgical centers within the assigned territory. Key Responsibilities Achieve agreed sales growth targets. Conduct field sales calls, solicit orders, and promote assigned Medtronic Spinal and Biologics products. Present, provide in-service training, and sell products and services to current and potential clients. Support and advise physicians and clinical staff on the correct and safe use of Medtronic devices. Lead clinical selling activities within the assigned territory. Identify sales prospects and contact new and existing accounts as assigned. Prepare action plans and schedule activities to identify specific targets and project the number of contacts to be made. Follow up on new leads and referrals resulting from field activities. Interact with purchasing managers and hospital administrators to negotiate and establish broader sales contracts. Monitor local market trends and competitor activity, reporting insights to the District Manager. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of commercial experience within the medical device industry. Demonstrated strong relationship management skills. Excellent communication skills. Natural ability to identify business opportunities. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves working within an assigned territory to engage with current and potential clients, including hospitals and surgical centers. The role requires maintaining awareness of local competitive conditions and representing Medtronic in accordance with company policies and standards.

This full-time role focuses on providing customer support, handling inquiries, and resolving issues efficiently and professionally. The position operates on a shift-based schedule, with Friday designated as a fixed weekly day off. Key Responsibilities Respond to customer calls and messages across various communication channels, including phone, chat, and email, and manage their requests. Provide accurate information regarding products or services and promptly resolve customer issues and complaints. Follow up on open customer cases to ensure appropriate and satisfactory resolutions. Enter and update customer information, documenting interaction details within the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system. Collaborate with internal departments to ensure an excellent customer experience. Qualifications and Requirements 0-1 year of experience in a customer service role. Ability to work rotating shifts, with Friday as a fixed weekly day off. This full-time role is responsible for coordinating comprehensive marketing communication strategies to promote stc Group's New Markets and its subsidiaries' brands, both within the group and internationally. The analyst will ensure consistent messaging and brand identity in alignment with stc Group Corporate Communication, contributing to a positive brand reputation outside of Saudi Arabia. Key Responsibilities Lead the coordination of comprehensive marketing communication strategies for stc Group New Markets and its subsidiaries' brands, ensuring consistent messaging and brand identity in alignment with Corporate Communication. Facilitate communication expansion into new markets by focusing on marketing and communication strategies, ensuring consistent branding across all international markets in alignment with Corporate Communication and Strategy Excellence. Oversee the development of international message content (editorial, publications, newsletters) for the New Markets Business Unit to support and align with Corporate Communication efforts. Oversee brand strategy alignment for New Markets subsidiaries with the stc Group brand management team. Conduct market research through GP&A to tailor marketing communication strategies to each international market, coordinating with Corporate Communications to share insights and align messaging. 48481009ff4d98aa.description: About the Role Vertiv is seeking a Solution Architect for Data Centre Infrastructure to join its Infrastructure Solutions business unit in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is designed for data centre designers who focus on delivering infrastructure that is built, commissioned, and operated at scale. The successful candidate will represent the organization's full capabilities to customers, translating requirements into integrated, world-class data centre solutions. Role Context and Focus This position operates at the intersection of engineering, delivery, and client engagement, overseeing the entire journey from initial concept to real-world deployment. It requires an individual who understands both theoretical design principles and practical performance in live environments. Success in this role is built upon strong mechanical and electrical design capability across data centre systems, experience with constructed and operational facilities, and the ability to engage clients effectively to shape valuable solutions. Key Responsibilities Translate customer requirements into solution concepts using approved architectures and standards. Develop technical proposals, solution descriptions, and Bills of Material. Provide technical input and support to the Sales team during customer engagements, presentations, and clarifications. Apply Vertiv reference architectures, redundancy models, and design guidelines to all solutions. Ensure solutions align with portfolio positioning, cost models, and delivery constraints. Identify and escalate any deviations from standard architectures. Collaborate closely with internal engineering disciplines (electrical, mechanical, controls, services) and other support functions. Support the smooth handover of solutions into execution phases. Ensure solutions meet defined technical, compliance, and customer requirements. Clearly highlight technical risks, assumptions, and dependencies. Support validation against applicable standards, such as Tier intent and redundancy philosophy. Capture lessons learned from executed projects and contribute feedback to improve reference designs, tools, and solution guidelines. Actively develop technical and commercial understanding of Vertiv’s offerings. Required Experience and Qualifications 5-10 years of experience in data centre design and infrastructure. Strong mechanical and electrical design capability across data centre systems, with cross-discipline awareness. Experience with constructed, commissioned, and operational data centre facilities. Demonstrated ability to engage clients, translate requirements, and shape solutions that deliver measurable value. Company Overview Vertiv is a global provider of critical infrastructure and services for data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial environments. The company focuses on bringing together hardware, software, analytics, and ongoing services to ensure its customers’ vital applications run continuously, perform optimally, and grow with their business needs. Application Information This is a full-time position. Salary information will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

4827c15467de4ea5.description: About the Confectioner Role at Silversea Silversea is seeking a Confectioner to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This is a contract position requiring 5-10 years of experience. The Confectioner will be responsible for delivering high-quality, efficient, and technically excellent pastry preparation, ensuring adherence to company policies and public health standards, with a focus on guest satisfaction. Reporting Structure The Confectioner reports directly to the Executive Chef, Executive Sous Chef, and Pastry Chef. This role also involves supervising Assistant Pastry Chefs. Key Responsibilities Prepare and present high-quality pastries, desserts, petit fours, and baked goods for all meal services. Collaborate with the pastry team to ensure consistent production and presentation standards. Supervise daily pastry operations and provide support or act as a replacement for the Pastry Chef when required. Organize buffet displays, service stations, and special event dessert setups in accordance with company standards. Plan production schedules, manage requisitions, and coordinate special orders based on guest demand. Maintain food quality, ensure proper storage, control inventory, and minimize waste through cost-conscious production. Ensure cleanliness, sanitation, and compliance with food safety and public health regulations at all times. Monitor equipment condition, conduct basic maintenance, and report operational issues promptly. Support the training, onboarding, and development of pastry team members while fostering positive teamwork. Deliver exceptional guest service, accommodate dietary requirements, and adhere to all company policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), grooming, and conduct standards. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in pastry preparation. Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality and technically excellent pastry products. Strong understanding and strict adherence to public health and food safety standards. Work Type This is a Contract position. Application Process Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

48026c6d661ab062.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز اراك المتخصص لطب الاسنان عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في نجران. يركز هذا الدور على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع خطط علاجية شاملة، وتنفيذ مجموعة واسعة من المعالجات السنية للمرضى. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحوصات الشاملة للأسنان، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها لتشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة. إعداد خطط العلاج وبرامجها الزمنية بما يتناسب مع حالة كل مريض. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات السنية ومعالجة القنوات اللبية. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للمرضى. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرة شهادة جامعية في طب الأسنان. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص وعلاج مجموعة واسعة من أمراض الفم والأسنان. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى والزملاء. نوع العمل ومكان الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في نجران، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن بيئة عيادة متخصصة لتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

4857742225b3cb06.description: About the Role Saudi Xerox is seeking a Senior Officer Delivery to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves designing, deploying, securing, operating, and continuously improving enterprise network and cybersecurity environments across various infrastructures, including on-premises, private-cloud, public-cloud, and hybrid setups. The position requires providing hands-on technical delivery and managed-services support for critical security and networking functions. Key Responsibilities Manage enterprise firewalls, security gateways, and secure remote access across data centers, branches, and cloud environments. Configure and monitor IDS/IPS, threat prevention, web filtering, application control, and network malware protection. Design and manage virtual networks across public and private cloud platforms, including security groups, cloud firewall controls, and route tables. Administer EDR/XDR, anti-malware, host firewall, application control, device control, and endpoint detection policies. Implement DLP policies across endpoints, email, collaboration platforms, cloud services, and supported applications. Manage enterprise or cloud vaults, key stores, HSM integrations, and secrets-management services. Configure and review IAM users, roles, groups, service identities, policies, and privileged access using least privilege and segregation of duties. Integrate network, cloud, endpoint, identity, and security platforms with centralized monitoring, SIEM, SOC, and managed-detection services. Deliver implementation, migration, configuration, testing, handover, and ongoing support for cloud and on-premises network-security projects. Prepare HLD/LLD, method statements, implementation, test, and rollback plans, as-built records, and operational runbooks. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 7 years of hands-on experience in network, security, infrastructure, or cloud engineering roles. Experience supporting enterprise or managed-services environments across cloud and on-premises infrastructure. Hands-on implementation and troubleshooting of firewalls, routing, switching, VPNs, segmentation, endpoint protection, and security controls. Practical experience with at least one major public-cloud platform and the ability to work across additional platforms. Experience producing implementation documents, operational runbooks, and customer-facing technical reports. Education and Certifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Equivalent certified experience may be considered. Preferred certifications include recognized cloud architecture, cloud security, or cloud networking certifications. Preferred: CCNP Enterprise/Security, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, or equivalent network-security certification.
